summary: All nine phases delivered their stated objectives. Deviations from planned file lists were present in every phase but fall into three recurring justified patterns: (1) phase-01 making ResolvedConfig.records required caused runtime crashes in many pre-existing test fixtures, each of which received only a disabled records block with no behavior change; (2) tagged error types and exit-code wiring in src/domain/errors.ts and runLayers.ts were necessary to satisfy integration test requirements that refusals reach the CLI with a non-zero exit, mirroring the precedent set by SecurityPreflightError; (3) README.md was auto-regenerated by pnpm docs:cli alongside the planned docs/cli/reference.md whenever a Commander command changed. Commit subjects match exactly across all nine phases. No scope creep was observed: excluded-scope sections were respected, and boundary contracts were upheld.

findings.message: src/app/loadConfig.ts and src/domain/config/mergeLayers.ts were edited though not in the planned file list. Justified: loadConfig.ts is the only assembly point for ResolvedConfig; mergeLayers.ts required a one-line passthrough or records would silently vanish under overlays.

RecordsConfigSchema, resolveRecordsConfig(undefined) returning disabled, discriminated destination union, remote-form validation, and wiring into PhaxConfigSchema/ResolvedConfig all delivered as specified.
tests/unit/recordsConfig.test.ts present, covering the accept/reject contract at the unit layer as specified.
RunRecordManifestSchema, per-provider usage schemas, TokenUsageSchema discriminated union, assembleRecord (pure, takes a listing), and three provider extraction functions all delivered.
tests/unit/runRecord.test.ts, tests/unit/recordsAssemble.test.ts, tests/unit/recordsUsage.test.ts all present; 34 tests per handoff.
No planned edits; none were made. Optional fixture files left as-is with justification.

src/schemas/git.ts created though not planned. Justified: the repo stores all git-stdout parsers there; parseLsTreeZ belongs alongside parseDirtyPaths and parseChangedFilesOutput to keep the infra adapter thin.
writeTreeCommit, resolveRef, readTree, readBlob added to GitOps with temp-index plumbing; FakeGitImpl extended; 6 integration tests against real temp repos including dirty-working-tree invariant.
tests/integration/gitObjectPlumbing.test.ts present covering all required scenarios: dirty working tree unchanged, orphan-first commit, readback, multi-branch isolation.

17 integration/e2e test fixture files edited beyond the plan (orientBriefArtifact, perPhaseBranch, rateLimit, reconciliation, resume family, routing, runCarriesCompletion, stateMachineContract, telemetry/end-to-end, gateExhaustionResume, resetPhase, semanticTrace variants). Justified: phase-01 made ResolvedConfig.records required; each fixture only gained a disabled records block with no behavior change.

src/app/writeRecord.ts with RECORDS_BRANCH_NAME, WriteRecordResult four-variant union, single executePlan call site at every terminal outcome, no record for archival commits, exactly one record per phase — all delivered.
tests/integration/writeRecord.test.ts present with 9 tests covering two-attempt-log producing one record, failed-phase record with no sha, records off producing nothing, clean worktree invariant.

src/domain/errors.ts and src/app/executePlan.ts edited though not planned. Justified: the plan's own test strategy required the refusal to reach the CLI with a non-zero exit; writeRecord's only caller is executePlan, making this wiring unavoidable. Pre-existing test files extended rather than created.

decideRecordsDestination pure decision table, GitHubOps.visibility port/adapter/fake, refused variant on WriteRecordResult, acknowledgedUnknownVisibility field on InRepoRecordsDestinationSchema, and refusal wired to non-zero CLI exit — all delivered.
tests/unit/recordsDestination.test.ts present covering all five decision-table rows. One integration test confirms non-zero exit per plan.

src/domain/errors.ts (RecordsSyncRequiredError) and src/cli/commands/runLayers.ts (exit code mapping) edited though not planned. Justified: mirrors SecurityPreflightError/RecordsDestinationRefusedError precedent. tests/integration/modelPreflight.test.ts and tests/integration/setupFailure.test.ts needed records field after new preflight runs before model check.

reconcileRecordsSync covering the full reconciliation table, checkRecordsRunPreflight refusing before any phase spawns, cloneRepo/fetchRemote/remoteUrl in GitOps, writer targeting local clone for repo destination — all delivered.
tests/integration/recordsSync.test.ts present covering clone, re-clone-becomes-fetch, origin-mismatch refusal, local-only-history refusal, and run preflight naming the command.

src/domain/init/buildConfig.ts edited though not planned (WizardAnswers.records for single-write flow). tests/integration/cliProgram.test.ts edited for command count assertion. README.md auto-generated by pnpm docs:cli.

configureRecords use case, askRecordsAnswers three-question flow, phax records init --force and phax records sync commands, init wizard block, destination announced not asked, public-later disclosure, CLI artifacts regenerated — all delivered.

tests/integration/recordsInit.test.ts present with fake Prompt, covering transcript=no still configures, public+transcript demands remote, in-repo+transcript discloses risk, already-configured refusal, --force override, rejected remote URL fails before write.

src/app/executePlan.ts and src/cli/commands/publishPr.ts edited though not planned (needed to pass records config into publishRun). tests/unit/cli/ls.test.ts and tests/unit/cli/publishPr.test.ts needed records fixture. src/cli/program.ts planned but untouched — justified: records status is a subcommand of the already-registered group.

pushRecordsAtPublish at publish without ever failing publish, pending computed from refs with no persisted state file, computeRecordsPending, phax records status, phax ls RECORDS column, CLI artifacts regenerated — all delivered.

tests/integration/recordsPush.test.ts present covering: unpublished run leaves records local, publish pushes records, rejected push leaves publish successful and records pending, ls pending count, records status detail, records off no change.
src/cli/program.ts planned but untouched — justified: explain/list are subcommands of the already-registered records group; registerRecordsCommand covers them. README.md auto-generated.

explainRecord with five outcomes (records-disabled, commit-not-found, not-phax-commit, not-found with remoteConsulted, found), listRecords with --run filter, reads from local clone or remote-tracking ref, refresh on local miss, explicit offline message, CLI artifacts regenerated — all delivered. The additive commit-not-found outcome is sensible and does not collapse any planned outcome.

tests/integration/recordsExplain.test.ts present with 5 integration tests covering: rebase-survival via trailers, non-phax commit non-zero exit, offline local-miss message, skeleton/vibe-usage reporting, records list showing failed phase.
docs/acceptance-coverage.md (optional) not mentioned in handoff; may not have been updated. Low severity — behavioral coverage is confirmed by the integration tests.

attentionPoints: Vibe token field names (input_tokens, output_tokens) in extractVibeUsage are best-effort guesses — not confirmed against a live vibe session. Verify against ~/.vibe/logs/session/<id>/meta.json before relying on vibe usage figures in production.

unknown visibility + transcript on + no acknowledgedUnknownVisibility is not surfaced interactively in the wizard; affected projects must hand-edit phax.json. Users will encounter a write-time refusal with no prior prompt at the setup stage.

listRecords walks full branch history with no server-side narrowing when --run is absent; will slow down as the records branch grows. Acceptable under spec's no-retention non-goal but worth revisiting.

decideRecordsDestination is bypassed (early return) for repo destinations in writeRecord — correct per spec, but means visibility port is never consulted for dedicated-repo projects even when transcript is on. Confirm this remains correct if future phases add visibility-gated behaviour for dedicated destinations.

src/cli/program.ts is marked partially-matched in the reconciliation (planned touch in phases 08 and 09, not touched). Both handoffs explain the subcommands were already covered by registerRecordsCommand. Confirm against the actual command tree.
pointers: possible gap: docs/acceptance-coverage.md (optional in phase-09) not mentioned in handoff — confirm via manual check whether spec §8 acceptance criteria were recorded there.
